stories.story_fr: La Californie du Nord redevient le moteur du portefeuille au Q1 2026 avec +3,9% de CA et +5,6% de NOI a perimetre constant, portee par Santa Clara (+4,6%) et la reprise de San Francisco (+4,3%).
stories.story_en: Northern California is again the portfolio's engine in Q1 2026 with +3.9% same-property revenue and +5.6% NOI, led by Santa Clara (+4.6%) and the San Francisco rebound (+4.3%).
stories.quote: Northern California 3.9% 0.2% 5.6% (Year-Over-Year Change, Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025: Revenue, Operating Expenses, NOI)

stories.story_fr: Essex releve son dividende de 0,8% a 10,36$ par action, sa 32e hausse annuelle consecutive, un track record de distribution rare parmi les REIT residentiels.
stories.story_en: Essex raised its dividend 0.8% to $10.36 per share, its 32nd consecutive annual increase, a distribution track record rare among residential REITs.
stories.quote: Increased the dividend by 0.8% to an annual distribution of $10.36 per common share, the Company's 32nd consecutive annual increase

stories.story_fr: Le NOI a perimetre constant superieur aux attentes a permis au Core FFO de depasser de 0,11$ le point median du guidance au Q1 2026, signe d'une gestion locative efficace en cotier Ouest.
stories.story_en: Better-than-expected same-property NOI pushed Core FFO $0.11 above the guidance midpoint in Q1 2026, a sign of efficient West Coast leasing management.
stories.quote: Grew Core FFO per diluted share by 2.3% compared to the first quarter of 2025, exceeding the midpoint of the Company's guidance range by $0.11. The outperformance was primarily driven by favorable same-property net operating income ("NOI")

stories.story_fr: L'occupation financiere du portefeuille reste tendue a 96,5% au Q1 2026, en hausse continue sur l'annee, refletant une offre limitee sur les marches cotiers Ouest.
stories.story_en: Portfolio financial occupancy stays tight at 96.5% in Q1 2026, rising steadily over the year, reflecting limited supply across West Coast coastal markets.
